messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need my son's Vyvanse transferred to the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth. We're on vacation and he runs out Sunday.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help with that transfer. To get started, I need to verify your son's identity. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Sure, it's Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010.
AGENT: Great, I've verified Eli's account. I can see he's currently set up at our Harbor store H-501. Before I transfer his Vyvanse, I need to confirm which store you'd like it moved to. Can you give me the address of the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth so I can make sure I have the right location?  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: The one by the boardwalk, on Rehoboth Ave. It's near our rental. That's the one, can you just get it moved there?
AGENT: I want to make sure I have the right store. Let me search for that location for you. Perfect, that's H-601 at 200 Rehoboth Ave. Now let me pull up Eli's prescriptions to find the Vyvanse. I found Eli's Vyvanse at H-501. Since Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication, I need to let you know that a filled C-II can't be transferred—it needs a new prescription from Dr. Okafor instead. Before I request that new prescription at the Rehoboth store, I should confirm with our pharmacist that they can fill it there. Can I have you hold for just a moment while I flag this for our team?  [system actions: find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Can't you just push a button? It's the same chain, come on, it's not that complicated.
AGENT (LATEST): I understand the frustration, but with C-II medications like Vyvanse, even within our chain, we need a new prescription from the doctor rather than a transfer. What I can do right now is request a new prescription from Dr. Okafor to be sent to the Rehoboth store. That way it'll be ready for you by the time you need it Sunday. Should I go ahead and do that?

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks for the dose or strength
move_3: the agent mentions contacting the doctor
stop_0: Agent recaps the plan: store, new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor, after-hours line, pharmacist verification.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never asked about dose or strength"}, "move_3": {"met": true, "why": "Agent mentions requesting new prescription from Dr. Okafor"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of after-hours line or pharmacist verification here"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
